Goa Housing Board Recruitment 2026

The Goa Housing Board, Porvorim, has invited applications for the following posts on a regular basis:

Posts Available:
* Lower Division Clerk (LDC): 01 Post (EWS, Level 2)

* Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS): 01 Post (EWS, Level 1)

Essential Qualifications:

LDC: Higher Secondary School Certificate or AICTE-approved Diploma from a recognised State Board of Technical Education or equivalent; knowledge of computer applications/operations; English typing speed of 30 wpm; essential knowledge of Konkani (Marathi is desirable).

MTS: Passed Secondary School Certificate Examination from a recognised Board/Institution OR passed a course conducted by an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) or equivalent in a relevant trade; essential knowledge of Konkani (Marathi is desirable).

How to Apply: Eligible candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of necessary documents to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Goa on or before 26th November 2026. Application forms are available on the official website at www.ghb.goa.gov.in.

Documents Required: Birth certificate, educational qualification certificates, 15 years residence certificate in the State of Goa, employment card, Aadhaar card, experience certificate (where applicable), EWS certificate, and other relevant supporting documents.

Source: Herald | Date: 06-11-2026
